Name: Assignment ID
Description: The surrogate ID for the assignment. Only available when updating existing records.

Name: Assignment Number
Description: A number to uniquely identify the assignment.

Name: Work Terms Assignment ID
Description: A unique reference to the assignment number for the parent employment terms.

Name: Work Terms Number
Description: The number of the parent employment terms for this assignment.

Name: Effective End Date
Description: The end date of the date-effective changes. If this is not the last change for the effective start date, then the effective end date must equal the effective start date. If left blank, the effective end date is the end of time by default.

Name: Effective Latest Change
Description: Set to Y if this is the last change on the effective start date. Otherwise, set to N.

Name: Effective Sequence
Description: The sequence number of this change on the effective start date. For the first change on the effective start date, set this value to 1. For incremental changes, leave this value blank to generate the next number in the sequence.

Name: Effective Start Date
Description: The start date of the record or of date-effective changes to the record.

Name: Action Code
Description: The action being performed for this period of service record, such as, Hire, Add Pending Worker, or Add Contingent Worker.

Name: Adjusted FTE
Description: Label for the worker's adjusted FTE value.

Name: Annual Working Duration
Description: Label for the worker's annual working duration.

Name: Annual Working Duration Units
Description: Label for the unit for the worker's annual working duration.

Name: Annual Working Ratio
Description: Label for the worker's annual working ratio. This is calculated as multiple of assignment FTE and ratio of annual working duration and standard annual working duration.

Name: Assignment Category
Description: A user-defined category for the assignment, such as full-time permanent.

Name: Assignment Name
Description: Business title for the assignment.

Name: Assignment Standard Working Hours
Description: Label for the worker's standard working hours.

Name: Assignment Standard Working Hours Frequency
Description: Label for the worker's standard working hours frequency.

Name: Assignment Status Type
Description: The code for the assignment status type.

Name: Assignment Status Type ID
Description: The surrogate ID for the assignment status type.

Name: Assignment Type
Description: The type of the assignment, such as employee or contingent worker.

Name: Bargaining Unit
Description: The code for the bargaining unit.

Name: Business Unit
Description: The name of the business unit for the assignment.

Name: Business Unit ID
Description: A unique reference to the business unit for the assignment.

Name: Candidate Number
Description: Label for the candidate number field.

Name: Collective Agreement Code
Description: The code for the collective agreement.

Name: Collective Agreement ID
Description: The surrogate ID for the collective agreement.

Name: Contract ID
Description: A unique reference to the contract, that is attached to the existing assignment of the same work relationship.

Name: Contract Number
Description: The number of the contract, that is attached to the existing assignment of the same work relationship.

Name: Correct Assignment Termination
Description: To correct a terminated assignment, provide a value of Y and the corrected values for termination related attributes.

Name: Decommissioned: Primary Assignment for the Person
Description: Decommissioned: This attribute is now populated using the Primary Assignment for the Work Relationship on the Assignment component, Primary Employment for the Work Relationship attribute on the Employment Terms component and the Primary Employment attribute on the Work Relationship component. In a future release, this attribute will be removed from this HCM Data Loader Object definition.

Name: Default Expense Account
Description: The default expense account. If the expense account is configured with multiple segments, then provide the concatenated value. Separate the values using the separator configured for the expense account.

Name: Department
Description: The name of the worker's department.

Name: Deprecated - Billing Title
Description: Deprecated: This attribute is not used in the application and is not exposed on any interface. In a future release, this attribute will be removed from this HCM Data Loader object definition.

Name: Deprecated - Internal Location
Description: Deprecated: This attribute is not used in the application and is not exposed on any interface. In a future release, this attribute will be removed from this HCM Data Loader object definition.

Name: Deprecated - Project Title
Description: Deprecated: This attribute is not used in the application and is not exposed on any interface. In a future release, this attribute will be removed from this HCM Data Loader object definition.

Name: End Time
Description: The normal end time for the working day.

Name: Establishment ID
Description: A unique reference to the reporting establishment.

Name: Expense Check Send To Address
Description: Specifies the address where expense checks are to be sent.

Name: Freeze Start Date
Description: The date from when records should be hidden. The end of time by default.

Name: Freeze Until Date
Description: The date until when records should be hidden. The end of time by default.

Name: Frequency
Description: The frequency for the normal working hours, such as week or month. If Frequency is supplied, then the NormalHours attribute must also be supplied.

Name: Full Time or Part Time
Description: Indicates whether the worker is full-time or part-time.

Name: Grade Code
Description: The code of the assignment grade.

Name: Grade ID
Description: A unique reference to the worker's grade.

Name: Grade Ladder ID
Description: A unique reference to the worker's grade ladder.

Name: Grade Ladder Name
Description: The name of the grade ladder.

Name: Grade Step Progression Eligibility
Description: Indicates whether the assignment is eligible for grade-step progression.

Name: Hourly Salaried Code
Description: Identifies whether the assignment is paid by the hour or by salary. Maintained either at the assignment level or on the employment or placement terms, but not both.

Name: Internal Building
Description: Building information associated with the work location.

Name: Internal Floor
Description: The floor information for the work location.

Name: Internal Mail Stop
Description: The internal mail location.

Name: Internal Office Number
Description: The office number for the work location.

Name: Job Code
Description: The code for the worker's job.

Name: Job ID
Description: A unique reference to the worker's job.

Name: Labor Union Member
Description: Indicates whether the worker is a labor union member.

Name: Last Working Date
Description: Last working date for the assignment.

Name: Legal Employer Name
Description: Used to uniquely reference the parent work relationship if using user keys. The legal employer name specified on the work relationship.

Name: Location Code
Description: The code for the worker's location.

Name: Location ID
Description: A unique reference to the worker's location.

Name: Manager
Description: Indicates whether the worker is a manager.

Name: Notes
Description: Annotations about a date-effective assignment change.

Name: Notice Period
Description: The notice period for the assignment. Specify with the NoticePeriodUOM attribute.

Name: Notice Period Units
Description: The unit of measure for the notice period. Specify with the NoticePeriod attribute.

Name: Notification Date
Description: Notification date for the assignment.

Name: Offer ID
Description: Unique identifier for job offer.

Name: Organization ID
Description: A unique reference to the worker's department.

Name: Override Position
Description: Indicates whether attributes from the position can be overridden on the assignment when using position synchronization. Valid values are Y and N.

Name: Overtime Period Name
Description: The name of the overtime period.

Name: People Group
Description: If your people group is configured with multiple segments provide the concatenated value, separating the values with the separator configured for the People Group Key flexfield.

Name: Person ID
Description: Decommissioned: This attribute is not used in the application and is not exposed on any interface. In a future release, this attribute will be removed from this HCM Data Loader Object definition. The assignment object should be used for loading this attribute.

Name: Person Number
Description: The person number of the worker to whom this assignment belongs.

Name: Person Type
Description: The code for the person type.

Name: Person Type ID
Description: A unique reference to the person type.

Name: Position Code
Description: The code for the worker's position.

Name: Position ID
Description: A unique reference to the worker's position.

Name: Primary Assignment for the Work Relationship
Description: Indicates whether this is the primary assignment in the work relationship. Valid values are Y and N.

Name: Probation End Date
Description: The end date of the probation period.

Name: Probation Period
Description: The duration of the probation period. Specify with the ProbationUnit attribute.

Name: Probation Units
Description: The unit of measure for the probation period. Specify with the ProbationPeriod attribute.

Name: Projected End Date
Description: The date when the assignment is expected to end.

Name: Projected Start Date
Description: The proposed start date for the pending worker. This value is required for pending workers.

Name: Proposed Person Type
Description: The code of the proposed user person type.

Name: Proposed Worker Type ID
Description: A unique reference to the proposed worker type. This value is required for pending workers.

Name: Reason Code
Description: The reason for the action being performed on the record.

Name: Regular or Temporary
Description: Indicates whether the worker is regular or temporary.

Name: Rehire Authorizer Person ID
Description: A unique reference to the person who recommended that this worker not be rehired for the assignment.

Name: Rehire Authorizer Person Number
Description: The person number of the person who authorized that this worker cannot be rehired for the assignment.

Name: Rehire Reason
Description: The reason for the recommendation that this worker not be rehired for the assignment.

Name: Rehire Recommendation
Description: Indicates whether the person's rehire for the assignment is recommended.

Name: Reporting Establishment
Description: The name of the reporting establishment.

Name: Requisition ID
Description: Unique identifier for job requisition.

Name: Requisition Number
Description: Label for the requisition number field.

Name: Retirement Age
Description: The age at which the worker will retire.

Name: Retirement Date
Description: The planned retirement date.

Name: Reverse Assignment Termination
Description: A terminated assignment can be reversed by providing a value of Y.

Name: Review User Access
Description: By default the person's user access is removed one day after the termination date of the assignment. Specify I to request immediate removal of user access.

Name: Seniority Basis
Description: This attribute is applicable only if you are using V3 of the seniority dates feature. For V3, you must provide a value for this attribute. Otherwise, seniority dates will not be calculated for the worker. This attribute specifies the basis to be used for calculating seniority for a worker. If seniority is to be calculated based on calendar days, then you must set this attribute to ORA_PER_SNDT_DAYS.

Name: Source Assignment ID
Description: The surrogate ID for the assignment which is the source assignment for the legal employer change. This ID is only considered when performing a global transfer for an existing worker. If the user does not include the value for the source assignment number and the source assignment ID, then this happens: The primary assignment ID from the work relationship that is being terminated as part of the global transfer is defaulted as the source assignment ID.

Name: Source Assignment Number
Description: A number to uniquely identify the assignment which is the source assignment for the legal employer change. This number is only considered when performing a global transfer for an existing worker. This is a transient attribute for the assignment object and is used to determine the source assignment ID. If the user does not include the value for the source assignment number and the source assignment ID, then this happens: The primary assignment ID from the work relationship that is being terminated as part of the global transfer is defaulted as the source assignment ID.

Name: Special Ceiling Step
Description: The grade step for this assignment.

Name: Special Ceiling Step ID
Description: A unique reference to the grade step for this assignment.

Name: Standard Annual Working Duration
Description: Label for the worker's standard annual working duration.

Name: Start Date
Description: Used to uniquely reference the parent work relationship if using user keys. The date start specified on the work relationship.

Name: Start Time
Description: The normal start time for the working day.

Name: System Person Type
Description: An application-defined value that identifies a person type, such as employee or contingent worker.

Name: Tax Address ID
Description: A unique reference to the address used for taxation purposes. This can be different from a mailing address.

Name: Tax Reporting Unit
Description: A name to uniquely identify the tax reporting unit. This is a transient attribute for the assignment object and is used to determine the tax reporting unit ID.

Name: Tax Reporting Unit ID
Description: The surrogate identifier,ID, for the tax reporting unit. When you create a new worker or add a new assignment, this ID will be passed in the dat file as part of the assignment object. Note: You cant update this value in the assignment extension table.

Name: Terminate Assignment
Description: To terminate an assignment, provide a value of Y and the values for termination related attributes.

Name: Termination Date
Description: Termination date for the assignment.

Name: Union ID
Description: A unique reference to the worker union for the assignment.

Name: Union Name
Description: The name of the worker union for the assignment.

Name: Work at Home
Description: Specifies whether the worker works at home for this assignment.

Name: Worker Category
Description: The category of the worker, such as blue collar or civil servant.

Name: Worker Type
Description: Used to uniquely reference the parent work relationship if using user keys. The worker type specified on the work relationship.

Name: Working Hours
Description: The normal working hours, such as 37.5. Specify with the Frequency attribute.

Name: Source System ID
Description: A value to uniquely identify this record. This must be unique for the source system owner and business object component.

Name: Source System Owner
Description: The name of the source system used to generate the source system ID.

Name: Globally Unique ID
Description: The globally unique ID. Only available to reference existing records, it cannot be supplied for new records.

Name: Reference Context
Description: The context for the user-defined references provided for this component. Don't supply values for this attribute, instead specify the context against this attribute in the METADATA line using the format: SourceRefTableName= context. For example: SourceRefTableName=Store Information.
